issues.description: WIN-058b.c5 H2: numerical-strength asymmetry in κ-cluster cross-reference paragraph. Closing paragraph says "r > 0.96" but existing detail prose computes r ≈ 0.99 (mean 0.990, 90% CI 0.985–0.994). Cross-reference should use tighter value or explain why weaker threshold is used.

WIN-058b.c5 H3: carry-forward framing asymmetry within WIN-058b — opening says "in commit 6e06efb (2026-04-17)" but closing says "in a single 24-hour window". ISS-1223 fixed the cross-WIN asymmetry but did not touch WIN-058b closing. Preferred resolution: change WIN-058b closing to use "single commit" framing to match opening and WIN-058/062.
issues.verification_pattern: git show origin/main:data/wins.json | grep -qF "in a single commit, zero structural"

issues.description: WIN-061.c7 H1 (cross-WIN consistency): detail_evidence says H_eff >= 9,579 km but WIN-029/WIN-038 both use 9,572 km (c/(4*7.83)). Replace 9,579 with 9,572.
issues.verification_pattern: git show origin/main:data/wins.json | node -e "process.stdin.resume();let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const wins=JSON.parse(d);const w=wins.find(x=>x.id==='061');process.exit(w.detail_evidence.includes('9,572 km')?0:1);})"
